answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The quartz holds work receipts rather than names, so the opal of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the reef of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, rewards vest against future work.
